vaultSummary: Historical data for jobs that have run

fields.label: Job History Id
fields.description: History Job Id.  Each job run gets a unique Id

fields.label: Created At
fields.description: Date the history record was created

fields.label: Updated At
fields.description: Date the history record was updated.  Each run gets update every minute or so.  Most of these history records will not be for actively running jobs, the updated At will be considered the end time of the job.

fields.label: Progress
fields.description: JSON object showing each step of the job and the outcome.  We are using the last entry to pull the error message if the job failed.

fields.label: Error Message
fields.description: Text error message if the job failed (Success = false)
